precheck.description: check for showtime seats without prices
precheck.sql:
SELECT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM "public"."showtimeSeat"
                WHERE "price" IS NULL
              ) AS ok

execute.description: backfill showtime seat prices from seat type
execute.sql:
UPDATE "public"."showtimeSeat" AS ss
              SET "price" =
                CASE s."type"
                  WHEN 'PREMIUM' THEN 35000
                  WHEN 'STANDARD' THEN 20000
                  WHEN 'ACCESSIBLE' THEN 20000
                END
              FROM "public"."seat" AS s
              WHERE ss."seatId" = s."id"
                AND ss."price" IS NULL

postcheck.description: verify all showtime seats have prices
postcheck.sql:
SELECT NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM "public"."showtimeSeat"
                WHERE "price" IS NULL
              ) AS ok

SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "public"."showtimeSeat" WHERE "price" IS NULL) AS "result"
